description: This file defines classes and functions related to Bill of Materials (BOM) management in ERPNext, including BOM tree structure, BOM validation, cost calculation, and data retrieval.

classes.name: BOMTree
classes.description: Represents a full tree structure of a BOM, including methods for tree creation and traversal.

classes.name: BOM
classes.description: Main class for BOM management, including validation, cost calculation, and data retrieval.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Generates a unique name for the BOM based on existing BOMs for the item.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the BOM before saving.

methods.name: get_item_det
methods.description: Retrieves item details for a given item code.

methods.name: get_routing
methods.description: Fetches routing operations associated with the BOM.

methods.name: set_bom_material_details
methods.description: Sets detailed material information for BOM items.

methods.name: set_bom_scrap_items_detail
methods.description: Sets detailed scrap item information for BOM.

methods.name: get_bom_material_detail
methods.description: Retrieves raw material details like UOM, description, and rate.

methods.name: validate_bom_currency
methods.description: Validates that the BOM currency matches the item's currency.

methods.name: get_rm_rate
methods.description: Calculates raw material rate based on selected method.

methods.name: update_cost
methods.description: Updates the cost of BOM items and recalculates total BOM cost.

methods.name: update_parent_cost
methods.description: Updates the parent BOM's item rate based on total cost.

methods.name: get_bom_unitcost
methods.description: Returns the unit cost of a BOM.

methods.name: manage_default_bom
methods.description: Sets or unsets the default BOM for an item.

methods.name: clear_operations
methods.description: Clears operations if BOM does not have operations.

methods.name: validate_main_item
methods.description: Validates the main finished good item.

methods.name: validate_currency
methods.description: Validates the currency of the BOM.

methods.name: update_stock_qty
methods.description: Updates stock quantities for BOM items.

methods.name: validate_uom_is_interger
methods.description: Validates that UOM and quantity are whole numbers if required.

methods.name: set_conversion_rate
methods.description: Sets the currency conversion rate.

methods.name: set_plc_conversion_rate
methods.description: Sets the price list conversion rate.

methods.name: validate_materials
methods.description: Validates raw material entries.

methods.name: check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive BOM references.

methods.name: traverse_tree
methods.description: Traverses BOM tree to list all related BOMs.

methods.name: calculate_cost
methods.description: Calculates total BOM cost including operations and materials.

methods.name: calculate_op_cost
methods.description: Calculates operation costs.

methods.name: update_rate_and_time
methods.description: Updates workstation rate and operation time.

methods.name: calculate_rm_cost
methods.description: Calculates raw material costs.

methods.name: calculate_sm_cost
methods.description: Calculates scrap material costs.

methods.name: update_new_bom
methods.description: Updates BOM references and rates.

methods.name: update_exploded_items
methods.description: Updates exploded BOM items.

methods.name: get_exploded_items
methods.description: Retrieves all raw materials including from child BOMs.

methods.name: company_currency
methods.description: Returns the company's currency.

methods.name: add_to_cur_exploded_items
methods.description: Adds items to current exploded items list.

methods.name: get_child_exploded_items
methods.description: Adds items from child BOMs to exploded items list.

methods.name: add_exploded_items
methods.description: Adds exploded items to BOM.

methods.name: validate_bom_links
methods.description: Validates that BOM is not linked with other active BOMs when deactivating.

methods.name: set_routing_operations
methods.description: Fetches routing operations if applicable.

methods.name: validate_operations
methods.description: Validates BOM operations.

methods.name: get_tree_representation
methods.description: Returns BOM tree structure.

methods.name: set_bom_level
methods.description: Sets BOM level based on parent BOMs.

methods.name: validate_scrap_items
methods.description: Validates scrap/loss items.
